notes: Nine consecutive localized object-state episodes are visible. Opening or removing a movable part is treated as the on transition; closing or reinserting it is treated as off. Each double-door cabinet is represented as one episode because its door movements occur within a single continuous manipulation sequence and separate disengaged cycles are not visible.
scene_description: A user surveys a kitchen and then sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, followed by the lids or drawers of several countertop appliances.
